SELECT 100.0 * SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) / (SUM(g.generation_mw) + SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0)) AS curtailed_percentage
FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min AS c
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = c.iso_id
JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = c.fuel_id
JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly AS g ON g.iso_id = c.iso_id
  AND g.interval_start_utc = date_trunc('hour', c.interval_start_utc)
  AND g.fuel_id = c.fuel_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
  AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'
  AND CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19';

WITH spp AS (
    SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'SPP'
), wind AS (
    SELECT fuel_id FROM core.dim_fuel WHERE fuel_code = 'wind'
), energy AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generated_mwh,
        SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) AS curtailed_mwh
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
    JOIN spp ON spp.iso_id = g.iso_id
    JOIN wind ON wind.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    FULL OUTER JOIN core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min c
      ON c.iso_id = g.iso_id
     AND c.interval_start_utc = g.interval_start_utc
     AND c.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE (g.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00' AND g.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00')
       OR (c.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00' AND c.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00')
)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailed_mwh / (generated_mwh + curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_percentage
FROM energy

WITH spp AS (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'SPP'), wind AS (SELECT fuel_id FROM core.dim_fuel WHERE fuel_code = 'wind'), totals AS (SELECT (SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g JOIN spp ON spp.iso_id=g.iso_id JOIN wind ON wind.fuel_id=g.fuel_id WHERE g.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00' AND g.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00') AS generated_mwh, (SELECT SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min c JOIN spp ON spp.iso_id=c.iso_id JOIN wind ON wind.fuel_id=c.fuel_id WHERE c.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00' AND c.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00') AS curtailed_mwh) SELECT 100.0 * curtailed_mwh / (generated_mwh + curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_percentage FROM totals

WITH peaks AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
  JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
    AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), peak_hours AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
  FROM peaks
  WHERE rn = 1
), totals AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) AS all_fuels_mw
  FROM peak_hours AS p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc
), shares AS (
  SELECT i.iso_code, 100.0 * t.wind_solar_mw / NULLIF(t.all_fuels_mw, 0) AS share_pct
  FROM totals AS t
  JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = t.iso_id
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN share_pct END) AS answer
FROM shares

WITH iso AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code
  FROM core.dim_iso
  WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
), ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT i.iso_code, b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw, b.net_generation_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.iso_code ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
  WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
    AND b.demand_mw IS NOT NULL
), peak AS (
  SELECT iso_code, iso_id, interval_start_utc, net_generation_mw
  FROM ranked_peaks WHERE rn = 1
), shares AS (
  SELECT p.iso_code,
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(p.net_generation_mw, 0) AS renewable_share_pct
  FROM peak p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_code, p.net_generation_mw
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN renewable_share_pct END) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM shares

WITH hub AS (
  SELECT l.location_id
  FROM core.dim_location l
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = l.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO' AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB' AND l.location_type = 'hub'

    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'

  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r

    AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), rt AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rt_hour) AS avg_rt
  FROM rt_hourly
)
SELECT rt.avg_rt - da.avg_da AS rt_minus_da_usd_per_mwh
FROM rt CROSS JOIN da

WITH gen AS (
  SELECT g.interval_start_utc, SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw

  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id

), candidates AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw - gen.wind_solar_mw AS net_load
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b JOIN gen USING (interval_start_utc)
  WHERE b.iso_id = 1 AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  ORDER BY net_load DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC
  LIMIT 1
), rt AS (
  SELECT r.interval_start_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg

  JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id

    AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), prices AS (

  JOIN core.dim_location ld ON ld.location_id = da.location_id AND ld.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'

)

 JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id=b.iso_id
 WHERE i.iso_code='CAISO' AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-20'

 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY net_load DESC, hour_utc ASC) AS rn FROM x

WITH target_isos AS (
    SELECT iso_id, iso_code
    FROM core.dim_iso
    WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
),
peak_hours AS (
    SELECT
        i.iso_code,
        b.iso_id,
        b.interval_start_utc,
        b.interval_start_local,
        b.demand_mw,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.iso_id
            ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN target_isos AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
),
peak_generation AS (
    SELECT
        p.iso_code,
        p.demand_mw,
        p.interval_start_utc,
        SUM(g.generation_mw) FILTER (WHERE f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')) AS wind_solar_mw,
        SUM(g.generation_mw) AS total_net_generation_mw
    FROM peak_hours AS p
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
      ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE p.rn = 1
    GROUP BY p.iso_code, p.demand_mw, p.interval_start_utc
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        iso_code,
        100.0 * wind_solar_mw / NULLIF(total_net_generation_mw, 0) AS share_pct
    FROM peak_generation
)
SELECT
    MAX(share_pct) FILTER (WHERE iso_code = 'CAISO') -
    MAX(share_pct) FILTER (WHERE iso_code = 'ERCOT') AS difference_percentage_points
FROM shares

WITH iso AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code
  FROM core.dim_iso
  WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
), peak AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
    AND b.demand_mw IS NOT NULL
), selected AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
  FROM peak WHERE rn = 1
), shares AS (
  SELECT s.iso_id, s.demand_mw,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) / MAX(b.net_generation_mw) * 100.0 AS renewable_share_pct
  FROM selected s
  JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b
    ON b.iso_id = s.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = s.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = s.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = s.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY s.iso_id, s.demand_mw
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_share_pct END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN renewable_share_pct END) AS answer
FROM shares sh JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = sh.iso_id
